Saray turkish cuisine
Grazie mille per la sua splendida recensione ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐!

Tutto il team di Saray Turkish Cuisine la ringrazia per la fiducia e per aver condiviso la sua esperienza.

Siamo lieti che abbia apprezzato la nostra autentica cucina turca e che abbia trovato il ristorante facilmente raggiungibile. Anche se siamo leggermente fuori dal centro, cerchiamo ogni giorno di offrire ai nostri ospiti un'esperienza che valga il viaggio.

I nostri chef, ispirati alla tradizione culinaria di Istanbul, preparano con passione specialità turche autentiche come kebab, Iskender Kebab, grigliate alla brace, mezze, baklava e molte altre delizie.

Speriamo di avere presto il piacere di accoglierla nuovamente da Saray Turkish Cuisine, per farle scoprire ancora di più i sapori e l'ospitalità della Turchia nel cuore di Tunisi.

The service is mediocre unforgivable rudeness!!
Mar 2026 • Solo
Just 15 minutes after being served, when I hadn’t even finished my dish, a waitress took it away with food in it.

When I pointed out that I was still eating, his answer was shocking:
“You occupy a table of 4, I have a group to place.”

In other words, finishing my meal went after their management of the tables.

I had to ask myself if I should leave the premises. Meanwhile, other tables — served before me — were still busy, and the tea I had ordered was never served.

This is a total lack of respect for the customer. You don't pay to be in a hurry to leave in the middle of a meal.

Too bad, because the food is good... but the portions are very small, and the service is enough to completely spoil the experience.

Beautiful discovery
Mar 2026 • Solo
Frankly, I the fanatic of Tunisian cuisine was very septic about trying another kitchen and I do not hide you, I hesitated! And then I thought, I'm going to get started and to tell you the truth, I didn't regret it! Everything was excellent from start to finish! 

As a starter, I was treated to a lentil soup, I think I will not forget this taste of my life so good! There was also hummus, I'm not a fan but I liked this one, light and not very acidic. 

As a main course, I took a mix of chicken, grilled over a wood fire at what seems, tender and crisp, I could not overcome. 

And then there was this Lben (Turkish fermented milk) very refreshing and of absolute finesse and which accompanied me throughout my meal. 

Of course, this couldn't end without a glass of tea! Be careful though, size accuracy: Turkish drink tea without sugar but you can add sugar if you want. 

Recommend without hesitation!

Good Casual Dining - Friendly Atmosphere
Sep 2025 • Family
Had a very nice dinner at this restaurant after reading other reviews and because It was a short taxi ride from our hotel. I would describe the furnishings/decor more like a diner or cafeteria. The kitchen with open grill is in view of most patrons. The menus had photographs and English language descriptions. We were served by a waitress who spoke English. The food was excellent, the portions were generous, and the food was hot. The cost was more than reasonable. I recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants a good, tasty meal served in a casual atmosphere. I would go back if I were to return to Tunis.
